text:
Ava (Product Designer): mockups attached — trying a compact visual for role inheritance. shows parent role -> child role edges and a small legend. thoughts? :eyes:
Sam (PM): i like the compactness, but worried it hides transitive perms. can we show explicit/inherited badge on hover?
Raj (Frontend): hover badges are fine. question: do we need +/- collapse for deep hierarchies? large orgs will have 4-5 layers.
Ava (Product Designer): good call. proposal: collapsed nodes with a count chip, expand on click. hover reveals 'inherited from X' pill.
Elena (Accessibility): please make sure the color-only differences in the legend have text labels and focusable targets. keyboard users must be able to read inheritance source. also need 4.5:1 contrast for any legend text.
Marta (Design Ops): UX ops note — avoid adding a second modal. expansion should be inline so audit-trail context isn't lost.
Raj (Frontend): preliminary css for legend:
```
.legend .chip { padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 12px; }
.legend .inherited { background: #F0F7FF; color: #0B66C2; }
.legend .explicit { background: #EEF7EE; color: #137333; }
```
We can tweak colors to meet contrast.
Ava (Product Designer): copy question: should the hover pill say "Inherited from Admin" or "Assigned via Admin role"? shorter is better for small screens.
Sam (PM): prefer "Inherited from Admin" — clearer for non-technical end users.
Elena (Accessibility): also expose the inheritance as text in the DOM, e.g., "Role: ReadOnly (inherited from Admin)" so screenreaders announce it. tooltips alone aren't enough.
Raj (Frontend): noted. we'll expose an ARIA live region on expand and add an offscreen sentence for SR: `Assigned via Admin role (inherited)`
Ava (Product Designer): mobile layout: stack legend below graph, make chips tappable. count chip should be the primary affordance for expanding.
Marta (Design Ops): small nit — update component library story and add a variant test for >200 nodes.
ux-bot: Prototype updated: https://figma.com/proto/xyz — comments enabled. :robot_face:
Ava (Product Designer): thanks all — i'll update the figma with the aria copy and bring a new iteration to next wed design review. :thumbsup:
